description: Tap hieu chinh: dung de phat trien va chon nguong cho detector

scenarios.story: GrabFood tinh hoa hong 30% thay vi 25% theo hop dong trong 3 tuan
Nhan vien bo qua nhap 20% don san vao POS (binh thuong 3%)
Vi pham FIFO, nguyen lieu tuoi hong nhieu: hao hut x1.15-1.30
Quan ly dieu 55% nhan vien ca toi sang ca sang: toi qua tai, sang thua nguoi
Mat cap nguyen lieu gia tri cao truoc ky kiem ke 30/6
1 thu ngan huy hoa don tien mat sau khi da thu tien (12% don tien mat cua nguoi nay)
Minh hoa van hanh thu: dieu 55% nhan vien ca toi CN3 sang ca sang trong 2 tuan
Minh hoa van hanh thu: ShopeeFood tinh hoa hong CN1 cao hon hop dong trong 2 tuan

_ghi_chu: Tap 'live': moi truong van hanh thu hang ngay (Airflow), khoi tao bang ban sao tap phat trien; KHONG dung de danh gia. S1-S6 la ban sao kich ban tap phat trien (truoc 09/09/2024); L1, L2 la su co minh hoa cai cho cac ngay sau, de demo luong 'du lieu moi -> phat hien'. Bo phat hien khong doc tep nay.
